#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""ダッシュボードの「銘柄チャート検索」用のデータを作る。

rs_watchlist.py --save-ohlcv で保存した全銘柄の日足(始値・高値・安値・終値・出来高)から、次を作る。
  search/search_index.json   ティッカー・社名・RSレーティング・セクター・どの分割ファイルにあるか
  search/search_px_<k>.json  日足(直近 DAYS 営業日)。銘柄をティッカー順に CHUNKS 個へ分けたもの
レポートの分析条件(RS80以上など)に関係なく、ユニバースの全銘柄を載せる。判定には使わない。

使い方:
  python make_search_data.py --ohlcv <pickle> --out output
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import io
import json
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DAYS = 300
CHUNKS = 10


def names(cache_path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """上場銘柄一覧(nasdaqtrader)の社名。ティッカーはYahoo形式に直す。取れた社名は name_cache.json に足していき、取れないときはそれを使う。"""
    sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
    import rs_watchlist as rw

    out = {}
    for url, col in [(rw.NASDAQ_LISTED, "Symbol"), (rw.OTHER_LISTED, "ACT Symbol")]:
        try:
            df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(rw.fetch_text(url)), sep="|")
        except Exception as e:  # 社名が取れなくてもチャートは出せる
            print(f"社名の取得に失敗:{e}", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        for s, n in zip(df[col], df["Security Name"]):
            if not isinstance(s, str) or not isinstance(n, str):  # 空欄の行(pandas 3 では astype(str) でも NaN のまま)
                continue
            t = s.replace(".", "-").replace("/", "-")
            n = n.split(" - ")[0].strip()
            out[t] = n
    cache = json.loads(cache_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if cache_path.exists() else {}
    cache.update(out)
    cache_path.write_text(json.dumps(cache, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    return cache


def rnd(v: float):
    if v is None or pd.isna(v) or math.isinf(v):
        return None
    v = float(v)
    a = abs(v)
    return round(float(v), 4 if a < 1 else 3 if a < 10 else 2)


def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--ohlcv", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="output")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    out = Path(args.out)
    so = out / "search"
    so.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    full = pd.read_pickle(args.ohlcv)
    close = full["Close"]
    days = close.dropna(how="all").index[-DAYS:]
    full = full.reindex(days)
    cnt = full["Close"].notna().sum()
    tickers = sorted(t for t, n in cnt.items() if not str(t).startswith("^") and n >= 20)

    base = sorted(p.stem.split("_")[-1] for p in out.glob("rs_ratings_*.csv"))[-1]
    rr = pd.read_csv(out / f"rs_ratings_{base}.csv").set_index("ticker")["rs_rating"].to_dict()
    sec_cache = json.loads((out / "sector_cache.json").read_text()) if (out / "sector_cache.json").exists() else {}
    prof = json.loads((out / "profile_cache.json").read_text()) if (out / "profile_cache.json").exists() else {}
    sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
    import rs_watchlist as rw
    nm = names(out / "name_cache.json")

    arr = {c: full[c].reindex(columns=tickers).to_numpy() for c in ["Open", "High", "Low", "Close", "Volume"]}
    col = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(tickers)}
    per = math.ceil(len(tickers) / CHUNKS)
    index = []
    dates = [d.date().isoformat() for d in days]
    for k in range(CHUNKS):
        part = tickers[k * per:(k + 1) * per]
        rows = []
        for t in part:
            j = col[t]
            f = {c: arr[c][:, j] for c in arr}
            first = int((~pd.isna(f["Close"])).argmax())  # 上場が新しい銘柄は途中から
            lvl = np.nanmedian(f["Close"][first:]) if np.isfinite(f["Close"][first:]).any() else 100
            nd = 4 if lvl < 1 else 3 if lvl < 10 else 2
            def lst(x, nd):
                x = np.round(x.astype("float64"), nd)
                return [None if not np.isfinite(v) else v for v in x.tolist()]
            vol = f["Volume"][first:].astype("float64")
            rows.append({"t": t, "s": first,
                         **{c[0].lower(): lst(f[c][first:], nd) for c in ["Open", "High", "Low", "Close"]},
                         "v": [None if not np.isfinite(v) else int(v // 100) for v in vol.tolist()]})
            p = prof.get(t, {})
            n = p.get("name") or nm.get(t)
            index.append({"t": t, "n": n if isinstance(n, str) and n else t, "k": k,
                          "rs": int(rr[t]) if t in rr and not pd.isna(rr[t]) else None,
                          "sec": rw.YAHOO_TO_GICS.get(p.get("sector_yahoo") or sec_cache.get(t) or "") or ""})
        body = {"dates": dates, "rows": rows,
                "meta": [{"label": "make_search_data.py", "value": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "type": "code", "lang": "python"},
                         {"label": "Input", "value": "Yahoo Finance(全銘柄の日足。出来高は100株単位)"}]}
        (so / f"search_px_{k}.json").write_text(json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")), encoding="utf-8")
    idx = {"rows": index, "meta": [{"label": "make_search_data.py", "value": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "type": "code", "lang": "python"},
                                   {"label": "Input", "value": f"rs_ratings_{base}.csv、nasdaqtraderの上場銘柄一覧、Yahoo Finance"}]}
    (so / "search_index.json").write_text(json.dumps(idx, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":")), encoding="utf-8")
    sizes = [(so / f"search_px_{k}.json").stat().st_size for k in range(CHUNKS)]
    print(f"{len(tickers)}銘柄、{len(dates)}営業日、分割{CHUNKS}個(最大{max(sizes) / 1e6:.1f}MB、合計{sum(sizes) / 1e6:.1f}MB)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
